metadata.description: Name of the Consumption Logic App. Must be passed explicitly so a redeploy updates this playbook instead of standing up a parallel one.
Linux Consumption Function App hosting the AbuseIPDB enrichment shard. Globally unique.
Runtime storage account for the Function App. Globally unique, <=24 lowercase alphanumerics. Holds no security data.
Azure region of the playbook, the function app and the API connection.
Key Vault holding the Trackspace service-account password and the AbuseIPDB API key.
Key Vault secret holding the raw AbuseIPDB API key. Read by the LOGIC APP and passed to the function as a bearer token; the function app never sees the vault.
Log Analytics workspace backing the function's Application Insights component.
Storage account holding the Palo Alto EDL blob that is reviewed.
In-flight AbuseIPDB lookups per shard. 5 shards x this = concurrent requests seen by the API gateway.
Whole-word matched against the AbuseIPDB ISP, domain and hostnames. Edit here to change what counts as a finding.
Extra CIDRs treated as internal on top of RFC1918 and friends, e.g. owned public ranges.

body.note: The review runs asynchronously; see the run history for the result.

runError.message: @{concat('Chunking produced ', string(length(outputs('Compose_shards'))), ' shards but only 5 Enrich_shard_* actions exist. Part of the blocklist would go unreviewed.')}

fields.description:
The following IPs should be reviewed in @{outputs('Resolve_blob_target')['path']}:

||IP||vendor||Abuse Confidence Score||
@{join(body('Build_table_rows'), decodeUriComponent('%0A'))}

----
Source: @{parameters('StorageAccountName')}/@{outputs('Resolve_blob_target')['container']}/@{outputs('Resolve_blob_target')['path']} — @{length(body('Filter_blocklist_entries'))} entr(ies) scanned, @{outputs('Compose_scan_summary')['checked']} checked against AbuseIPDB, @{outputs('Compose_scan_summary')['skipped']} skipped (public CIDR ranges), @{outputs('Compose_scan_summary')['invalid']} unparseable, @{outputs('Compose_scan_summary')['errors']} lookup error(s).
Filter: vendor keywords [@{join(parameters('VendorKeywords'), ', ')}] matched whole-word against the AbuseIPDB ISP, domain and hostnames, plus private (RFC1918 and friends) address space. Internal addresses are never sent to AbuseIPDB, so their score reads n/a.
Raised automatically by the blob-review Logic App, run @{workflow().run.name}.

inputs.message: @{concat('No vendor or internal addresses found in ', outputs('Resolve_blob_target')['path'], '; no CLOPSSEC ticket raised.')}

runError.message: @{concat('Blob ', parameters('StorageAccountName'), '/', outputs('Resolve_blob_target')['container'], '/', outputs('Resolve_blob_target')['path'], ' yielded no usable entries. Treated as a fetch or format problem, not an all-clear.')}
